summary: Gradle buildSrc convention plugins + API-first client distribution. 3 plugins (kotlin-base, ktor-service, ktor-db-service), version catalog bundles, all services generate server+client stubs, consumer services replace GenerateTask blocks with typed dependencies.
Three epics created for Gradle Build Infrastructure Modernisation: #1365 (convention plugins), #1366 (client distribution), #1367 (consumer migration). Linked as sub-issues of #1365.
